name: research_review_scaffold
title: Research Review Scaffold
description: Create a low-entropy review workspace from a research intention

project_dir.description: Project root where the review workspace should be created

research_intention.description: Concise statement of the review topic or research question

review_dir.description: Relative directory path for the review workspace, defaulting to review

chat_context.description: Optional chat excerpts or notes that clarify the review intention and theme wording

theme_count_hint.description: Optional preferred starting theme count; default behavior is approximately 3 themes

overwrite.description: If true, replace existing scaffold files in the target review workspace

dry_run.description: If true, return the scaffold plan without writing files
